name: Hillside Village Shopping Center
summary: Hillside Village is an open-air lifestyle center in Cedar Hill featuring popular retailers, restaurants, and community-focused amenities including a fountain/splash pad and Village Green event space. The center serves as a vibrant gathering place for families and neighbors, hosting regular events and activities that bring the community together.
demographics: Hillside Village attracts primarily middle to upper-middle income families from Cedar Hill and surrounding DFW suburbs, with a strong presence of households earning $75,000-$150,000 annually. The trade area serves a diverse demographic mix including young families with children who utilize the splash pad and family-friendly events, as well as professionals aged 25-54 seeking convenient shopping and dining options. The center's Village Green gathering space and community events indicate a focus on lifestyle-oriented shoppers who value experiential retail and outdoor amenities alongside traditional shopping needs.
description: Hillside Village Shopping Center is Cedar Hill's premier open-air lifestyle destination, offering a vibrant blend of shopping, dining, and community gathering spaces that bring neighbors together. Managed by PREP Property Group, this thoughtfully designed center features familiar chain retailers alongside local favorites, all arranged around the inviting Village Green - a central gathering space that hosts family-friendly events throughout the year. The center's signature fountain and splash pad have become beloved community amenities, providing a refreshing retreat for families during warm Texas days. Beyond retail therapy, Hillside Village cultivates a true sense of community through regular store events, promotions, and seasonal gatherings that encourage residents to get outside and connect with their neighbors. With convenient access from FM 1382 and a strong social media presence showcasing daily happenings, Hillside Village has established itself as more than just a shopping center - it's a cornerstone of Cedar Hill's social fabric where shopping, dining, and community life seamlessly intersect.
